Title: ODC accession number
Description: ODC-SCI assigned accession number (dataset ID); automatically assigned at time of dataset creation

Title: DOI
Description: DOI assigned to dataset; assigned by ODC-SCI when approved for publication

Title: Dataset title
Description: Published dataset title

Title: Dataset type
Description: Identifies type of subject data contained in the dataset; datasets may include one or more types of data [Permitted Values: Animal: data produced from animal subjects. Clinical: data produced from human subjects (deidentified). In vitro: data produced from cell culture. Other: data produced from other source (i.e. synthetic and/or derived from previously published source).]

Title: Publication year
Description: Calendar year dataset was published on ODC-SCI

Title: Publication date
Description: Date of publication to ODC-SCI Public Space (i.e., activation of DOI by Laboratory PI)

Title: Laboratory name
Description: Name of the verified laboratory on ODC-SCI that published the dataset

Title: Study leader
Description: Name of the person(s) responsible for overseeing the project(s) that created the data

Title: Number of unique subjects in dataset
Description: Total number of unique subjects reported in the dataset (animal and/or deidentified human subjects); unique subject IDs associated with in vitro (cell) data are EXCLUDED from this count

Title: Species type(s) in dataset
Description: Species type(s) reported in the dataset [Permitted Values: Cat. Human (deidentified). Monkey. Mouse. Pig. Rat]
PermittedValues: Cat; Human (deidentified); Monkey; Mouse; Pig; Rat

Title: Strain type(s) in dataset
Description: Strain type(s) reported in the dataset; applies if response to variable "DatasetTyp" is "Animal" or "In vitro"

Title: Sex type(s) in dataset
Description: Sex type(s) reported in the dataset [Permitted Values: Female. Male. Unknown: data marked unknown by author. Not reported: data not reported and/or variable missing from dataset.]

Title: Vendor or origin of the subjects
Description: Vendor or origin of research subjects reported in the dataset; applies if response to variable "DatasetTyp" is "Animal" or "Cell"

Title: Age of subjects (range reported)
Description: Categorised age range of subjects in the dataset; categories approximate different life phases of the subject (binned as months for rodents/cats, years for primates) [Permitted Values if "DatasetTyp" is "Animal": 0-3 months. 4-6 months. 7-12 months. 12-24 months. 0-4 years. 5-10 years. Permitted Values if "DatasetTyp" is "Clinical": Adult: 18+ years. Pediatric: <18 years.]
PermittedValues: 0-3 months; 4-6 months; 7-12 months; 12-24 months; 0-4 years; 5-10 years; Adult; Pediatric; Not reported

Title: Weight range of subjects
Description: Weight range of subjects reported in the dataset; timing of reported weight measurement is NOT standardised across datasets to a single specific experimental time/milestone (e.g., injury, treatment, etc.)

Title: Type or model of injury
Description: Type(s) of spinal cord injury reported in the dataset [Permitted Values when "DatasetTyp" is "Animal": Contusion. Crush. Dorsal column lesion. DLQ: Dorsolateral Quadrant. Hemisection. SNI: Spared Nerve Injury. Transection. Permitted Values when "DatasetTyp" is "Clinical": Neurologically intact. Non-traumatic. Traumatic. Not reported.]
PermittedValues: Contusion; Crush; Dorsal column lesion; DLQ; Hemisection; SNI; Transection; Neurologically intact; Non-traumatic; Traumatic; Not reported

Title: Anatomical level of spinal cord injury
Description: Anatomical level of spinal cord injury [Permitted Values: Cervical. Thoracic. Lumbar.]

Title: Spinal cord level of the injury
Description: Spinal cord level at which the injury was assessed (humans) or performed (animals) including segment and number (e.g. C5)

Title: Injury laterality
Description: Laterality of planned SCI lesion (i.e., unilateral, bilateral, midline); applies if response to variable "DatasetTyp" is "Animal"

Title: Device used for injury
Description: Name of the device(s) used for the injury; applies if response to variable "DatasetTyp" is "Animal"

Title: Clinical injury severity
Description: ASIA Impairment Scale score; applies if response to variable "DatasetTyp" is "Clinical." Individuals without a spinal cord injury (i.e., neurologically intact) do not receive an AIS Grade [Permitted Values: A: Complete - no sensory or motor function is preserved in sacral segments S4-S5, no sacral sparing. B: Sensory Incomplete - sensory but not motor function is preserved below the neurological level and includes sacral segments S4-S5, and no motor function is preserved more than three levels below the motor level on either side of the body. C: Motor Incomplete - motor function is preserved below the neurological level and more than half of the key muscle functions below the neurological level of injury have a muscle grade of less than 3 (Grades 0-2). D: Motor Incomplete - motor function is preserved below the neurological level and at least half (half or more) of the key muscle functions below the neurological level of injury have a muscle grade ≥3. E: Normal - if sensation and motor function are graded as normal in all segments and the patient had prior SCI-related deficits.]

Title: Contusion model details
Description: A list of programmed and actual contusion model parameters reported in the dataset and/or dataset metadata [Permitted Values: Force: Actual force reported by impactor. Displacement: Actual measure of spinal cord tissue displacement (dorsal-ventral) reported by impactor. Dwell time: Programmed impactor dwell time. Impactor tip size. Velocity: Actual velocity of impact reported by impactor. Weight. Weight drop height.]
PermittedValues: Force; Displacement; Dwell time; Impactor tip size; Velocity; Weight; Weight drop height

Title: Locomotor behaviour tests
Description: A list of locomotor behaviour tests [Permitted Values: BBB: Basso-Beattie-Bresnahan locomotor score. BMS: Basso Mouse Scale for locomotion. Catwalk: locomotor/gait analysis. Ladder walking.]

Title: Behaviour tests (non-locomotor)
Description: A list of non-locomotor behaviour tests reported in dataset

Title: Intervention type
Description: Broad classification of intervention type(s) reported in dataset [Permitted Values: Drug/agent. Genetic. Graft/cellular. Neuromodulation. Rehabilitative training. Other.]
PermittedValues: Drug/agent; Genetic; Graft/cellular; Neuromodulation; Rehabilitative training; Other

Title: Intervention agent/details
Description: Name and/or description of intervention agent/technique

Title: Author keywords
Description: Author keywords in metadata

Title: Related datasets
Description: Related datasets on ODC-SCI (e.g., datasets that contain the same subjects and/or contain related experimental data)

Title: Funders
Description: Funding agencies and/or institutions that provided support for the work described in the dataset

Title: CoDEs
Description: Indicates whether the dataset was published before or after the introduction of the data standards known as the Community Data Elements (CoDEs) [Permitted Values: Pre; Post]

Title: Study purpose
Description: Study purpose as described in the metadata

Title: Notes
Description: Notes
